title: Login page broken
body:
Opening /login shows 'Internal Server Error' instead of a login form.
Steps: open http://127.0.0.1:8000/login.
Expected: a page with a 'Log in' heading. Actual: HTTP 500.
label: bug

title: Search ignores capital letters
body:
Searching for 'login' finds nothing, although issue #1 is called 'Login page broken'.
Steps: open /issues?q=login.
Expected: search does not care about upper or lower case, so #1 is listed. Actual: no results.
label: bug

title: Typo on the About page: 'Trakcer' should be 'Tracker'
body:
The About page says 'Pocket Trakcer'.
Expected: 'Pocket Tracker' everywhere.
label: docs

title: Blank titles are accepted
body:
Creating an issue whose title is only spaces works and leaves a row with an empty title.
Steps: New issue, type three spaces as the title, press 'Create issue'.
Expected: HTTP 400 with the message 'Title is required', and no issue is created. Actual: the issue is created.
label: bug

title: Open-issue count includes closed issues
body:
The issue list heading says '10 open issues' although issue #10 is closed.
Steps: open /issues and compare the heading with the Status column.
Expected: the heading counts only open issues (9 on a fresh database).
label: bug

title: HTML in comments is rendered instead of shown as text
body: A comment containing hello shows 'hello' in bold. Anyone can inject markup or scripts into the page this way. Steps: add the comment hello to any issue. Expected: the comment shows the literal text hello.
label: bug

title: Closing an issue resets its label
body:
When I close an issue its label disappears.
Steps: open issue #2 (label 'bug') and press 'Close issue'.
Expected: the issue is closed and still labelled 'bug'. Actual: the label is empty.
label: bug

title: Saved filters
body: Let me save a search (text, status and label) under a name and open it again from the issue list.
label: feature

title: Due dates on issues
body: Each issue should have an optional due date, shown on the list, with overdue issues easy to spot.
label: feature

title: Explain the labels on the About page
body: New users do not know what 'bug', 'docs' and 'feature' mean.
label: docs
